title: Orlando Fishing Charters

services.name: Fishing Reports
services.desc: Because Orlando sits inland, most saltwater charters head toward the east coast, where the Indian River Lagoon, Mosquito Lagoon, and nearby coastal flats provide excellent inshore opportunities. These waters are popular because they combine shallow grass flats, mangrove shorelines, oyster bars, and protected areas
